I am a first-year Master of Business Analytics student at Monash University in Melbourne. I grew up in Mumbai.

Before Monash, I worked as a Junior Data Analyst and Database Manager at idigitalxp, where I looked after the data behind day-to-day decisions and turned it into reports people could act on. That work taught me that an analysis is only useful if the right person can understand it.

I work mainly in R, Python and SQL, and I build dashboards in Power BI and Tableau. I use Git and GitHub to keep my projects reproducible and open.

## What this blog is about

This blog is where I practise turning technical evidence into clear answers for the people it affects. Each post starts with a question a reader might actually ask, shows the evidence behind the answer, and is honest about what the evidence cannot tell you.

## Beyond analytics

I have led volunteer teams with AIESEC in Mumbai, and I held Discipline Head roles with the Computer Society of India and my college council. Those roles taught me to explain ideas to people with very different backgrounds, which is the skill this blog is built around.

## Contact

The best way to reach me is by [email](mailto:gauravwarke8@gmail.com) or on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/gaurav-warke-b5493b394/). My code is on [GitHub](https://github.com/GauravWarke).
